invariants.claim: On success, the selected prize address contains code, both selected addresses avoid the enumerated protocol destinations, the token returned ERC-721 interface support, and reserveEntries is nonzero.
On success, endTime was strictly later than the sampled creation timestamp and the sale duration was no more than 30 days.
The returned clone's identifier equals the incremented raffleCount and the factory's forward, reverse, and membership registries contain the same clone/ID pair.
The clone initialization returning path is factory-only and one-time, stores the supplied configuration, marks initialized, and leaves status AwaitingPrize before escrow.
The expected receiver path accepts only the configured prize token, token ID, sponsor, factory operator, and AwaitingPrize state, then stores Active.
RaffleCreated is emitted only after the selected token reports the clone as owner and the clone reports Active.
A nested createRaffle call during sponsor-selected external code execution is rejected by the entered factory guard.
